Queued with --no-expect because there is no second arm; this file is committed before the request so the readings below are bound by content hash in git rather than rationalised afterwards.

WHAT IS BEING DECIDED. Two handovers from the lane that finished #44 are mechanisms by inspection with no evidence that anything reaches them. (1) create_texture() takes pgraph_get_texture_length() from the UNADJUSTED shape while a bordered swizzled texture is decoded at max(16,2n) per axis, so four consumers -- the per-draw dirty poll and the mark-possibly-dirty overlap test via key.texture_length, the content hash that gates vram_changed, and download_surfaces_in_range_if_dirty -- are short by 4x in 2D, 8x in 3D, and up to 256x for the small bordered sizes (a 1x1 A8R8G8B8 bordered texture tracks 4 bytes of a 1,024-byte decode). (2) #56's guard covers the LRU-exhausted early return. Neither has been shown to fire. The probe counts the events instead of arguing about them, because the minimal fix to (1) moves a cache key, a test-and-clear dirty range and a surface-overlap range for EVERY bordered texture, and an unreachable defect wants a comment rather than that.

DISC: Texture border, Texture border color, Texture cubemap, Volume texture, TextureWrapMode -- 112 captures, chosen because Texture_border is the only suite in the corpus with texture-supplied borders (18 captures: 2D, 2D_BorderTex_SZ, nine 3D_BorderTex_SZ_*, six Cube_BorderTex_SZ_*, xemu#1034) and the other four are the nearest neighbours that could plausibly set BORDER_SOURCE_TEXTURE.

LEG P1 (liveness, and it gates every other leg): bordered_binds > 0. FAILS in the world where no test on this disc binds a non-linear texture with border_source != BORDER_SOURCE_COLOR -- in which case every zero below means 'not measured', not 'does not happen', and the run says nothing about task 1. This is the leg that stops a dead probe reading as a clean result.

LEG P2 (arithmetic, EXPLICITLY NOT A FALSIFIER -- my own code computes both sides): last_decoded > last_tracked on every bordered bind, with the ratio one of 4 (2D w,h>=8), 8 (3D), or a larger power of two for the small sizes. Asserting that the patch does what I think it does; it carries no information about silicon and is not counted.

LEG P3 (THE SUBSTANTIVE ONE): blind == 0, and therefore blind_via_poll == 0 and blind_via_hash == 0. Reasoning: every writer of a bordered texture in these suites is GenerateBordered2DSurface followed by swizzle_rect, which walks its SOURCE row-major (that is #44's own measured finding, prefix on 9 of 9 frontiers) and therefore always touches byte 0 of the region. A hash over the first quarter sees any such write. FAILS in the world where some test updates a bordered texture WITHOUT touching its tracked head -- the two concrete shapes are an interior-only rewrite of the coloured sub-rect at offset (4,4), and a bordered CUBEMAP whose faces 2..5 are rewritten alone: for a bordered 32x32 cube the tracked 24,576 bytes cover face 0 and part of face 1 of a 98,304-byte decode, so faces 2..5 lie wholly outside it. Nothing in my patch forces P3 either way -- the counter reads guest memory the tests write, and the goldens are not involved.

LEG P4 (#56): lru_exhausted == 0 and lru_exhausted_null == 0. Reasoning: the texture LRU is 512 or 1024 entries and texture_cache_entry_pre_evict refuses only the <=4 currently-bound nodes and nodes still in flight (submit_time + num_active_frames > submit_count), so exhaustion needs ~1,020 distinct textures bound inside one submit window. A 112-capture pgraph disc is not a texture-count workload -- #18 names Dead or Alive 3 as the one that would be. FAILS if any of these suites does churn that many distinct texture keys per frame, which Texture_cubemap's 72 captures make worth asking rather than assuming.

LEG P5: tail_surf == 0 -- no draw-dirty surface overlaps a bordered texture's decoded tail while missing its tracked head. FAILS if a render target is laid out over the second, third or fourth quarter of a bordered texture's region, which is the third of the four consequences and the one a capture could actually show.

This comparison is ADVISORY because the baseline has a different disc_id (five one-suite discs against one five-suite disc) and a different ref, and issue #15's order dependence can move a capture for disc composition alone. A capture other than 2D_BorderTex_SZ moving is therefore a reason to look, not a refutation on its own.

P3 > 0: land the length fix and A/B it on this same disc, judged on stale_px for 2D_BorderTex_SZ and per-capture better/worse for the rest.
